clips.title: The story
paras: Stendel's Pond is a small, tainted body of water located southwest of Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Surrounded by prowling gnolls and marked by nearby graves, it remains one of the few fresh fishing spots in the parched countryside despite its sinister hazards.

Tucked away southwest of Sentinel Hill, Stendel's Pond offers a quiet break from Westfall's dusty plains, though danger is never far. Gnolls roam the muddy banks, while scattered skeletons and a pair of lone graves suggest that either the waters or the beasts around it are fatal to careless travelers. Anglers still risk the trek for schools of sagefish.
